title: Norwegians with 24 teeth want to build craft with the US government

tellings.quote: the Norwegians with 24 teeth can only repair their craft when they get here, at least in 1965. One of the things they wanted to be able to do was to work with the American government and built craft here.

plain: In 1965, beings that Charles Hall calls "the Norwegians", who he says have 24 teeth, wanted to work with the American government and build their craft in the United States. Hall says he spent three years among tall white aliens at Area 51, a secret Air Force site in Nevada, and he tells Michels he knows this first-hand. By his account the Norwegians could only repair their craft once they got here, "at least in 1965", which, if true, would mean non-human visitors sought a building partnership with the US government.
